ev.q: During the 2023–24 respiratory virus season, influenza vaccination coverage was 80.7% among acute care hospital personnel and 45.4% among nursing home personnel.
Pooled mean influenza vaccination coverage among health care personnel working at acute care hospitals and nursing homes, by facility type
Coverage with influenza and 2023–2024 COVID-19 vaccination was higher among health care personnel in acute care hospitals than among those in nursing homes.
This analysis describes influenza and 2023–2024 COVID-19 vaccination coverage among health care personnel

methods_quotes.q: 95% CIs were calculated using the mid-P method.
Facilities that reported data for both vaccine types were included in the analysis.
results were categorized into levels based on the overall quintile distribution of coverage across both vaccines and both facility types.
